title: OpenAI Adds Rosalind Workbench for Life Sciences
summary: The new workspace connects specialized models, biological tools and reviewable evidence in a governed research workflow.
body:
## From model access to a research workspace

OpenAI has introduced Rosalind Workbench, a research-preview environment that connects life-science questions with specialized models, databases and computational tools. It extends the company’s existing GPT-Rosalind offering beyond a standalone model by organizing multi-step scientific work inside a reviewable workspace.

Researchers can use the system to inspect sequencing data, synthesize literature and biological evidence, compare therapeutic targets, examine proteins and variants, assess molecular candidates and plan follow-up experiments. A guided next-generation sequencing workflow checks uploaded files, proposes an analysis plan and exposes quality-control measurements and saved outputs before the user selects the next question.

The workbench can run directly through Codex, while eligible organizations may request GPT-Rosalind API access. OpenAI says workflows can be saved, shared and reused, an important distinction from chat sessions whose reasoning and tool calls are difficult for a scientific team to reconstruct. The broader Rosalind package connects to more than 50 public multi-omics databases, literature sources and biology tools.

OpenAI reports performance-per-token improvements of 53.7% on GeneBench, 18% on Medchem Bench and 19.6% on Labworkbench, with a smaller 4.42% gain on LifeSci Bench. These are company-selected evaluations and do not establish that the system improves laboratory success rates or drug-development outcomes.

## Controlled availability

Rosalind Workbench remains a research preview. Specialized GPT-Rosalind access is reviewed at the organizational level, with initial deployment governed by eligibility, security and biological-misuse controls. Mainline models and some connectors are more broadly available, but the most capable research mode is not an unrestricted public product.

## Why it matters

Scientific AI is shifting from question answering toward orchestration: selecting tools, carrying evidence between stages and preserving an inspectable record of decisions. Rosalind Workbench brings that approach into genomics, protein analysis and experimental planning, where provenance and human approval are essential. Its importance will depend less on benchmark gains than on whether research teams can reproduce its intermediate steps and demonstrate better experimental choices. Until prospective laboratory evidence appears, it should be regarded as a governed workflow system with promising reasoning support, not an autonomous scientist.
title_zh: OpenAI推出Rosalind生命科学研究工作台
summary_zh: 新工作台把专用模型、生物数据库、科研工具和可复核结果接入同一套受控研究流程。
body_zh:
## 从专用模型走向研究工作台

OpenAI 推出 Rosalind Workbench 研究预览版，把生命科学问题、专用模型、数据库和计算工具连接到同一环境。与此前单独提供 GPT-Rosalind 模型不同，新产品强调在可复核的工作区内组织多步骤科研任务。

研究人员可用它检查测序数据，汇总论文与生物学证据，比较治疗靶点，分析蛋白质和变异，评估候选分子，并规划后续实验。以二代测序流程为例，系统会检查上传文件、提出分析计划，并展示质量控制指标和已保存结果，再由使用者决定下一步研究问题。

工作台可以通过 Codex 直接运行，符合条件的机构还可申请 GPT-Rosalind API。OpenAI 表示，研究流程可以保存、共享和复用。对于需要团队复查的科学工作，这比难以重建工具调用与推理过程的普通聊天记录更有价值。Rosalind 整体工具包可连接 50 多个公共多组学数据库、文献来源和生物学工具。

公司公布的每 Token 性能数据显示，系统在 GeneBench、Medchem Bench 和 Labworkbench 上分别提高 53.7%、18% 和 19.6%，在 LifeSci Bench 上提高 4.42%。这些仍是企业自行选择的评测，不能证明它已经提高湿实验成功率或新药研发产出。

## 受控开放

Rosalind Workbench 目前仍处于研究预览阶段。专用 GPT-Rosalind 的访问资格以机构为单位审核，初期部署受安全、治理和生物滥用防护要求约束。部分连接器和通用模型开放范围更广，但能力最完整的研究模式并非任何人都能直接使用。

## 为何重要

科研 AI 正从回答问题转向编排完整流程：选择工具、在多个环节之间传递证据，并保留可检查的决策记录。Rosalind Workbench 把这一思路带入基因组、蛋白质分析和实验规划，而这些领域尤其依赖证据来源与人工审批。它最终是否重要，不取决于跑分涨幅，而取决于科研团队能否复现中间步骤，并证明确实作出了更好的实验选择。在出现前瞻性实验数据前，它更适合被视为一套带有推理能力的受控工作流，而不是“自主科学家”。
cat_take_zh: 四项跑分增幅从4.42%到53.7%不等，科研价值还得由真实实验复现来定。
cat_take_en: Benchmark gains ranging from 4.42% to 53.7% leave reproducible laboratory outcomes as Rosalind’s decisive missing evidence.
